prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the Cottonwood Library crayon illustration family. Generate a NEW original matching spot illustration. Extremely simple childlike wax-crayon drawing, sparse wobbly dark indigo #1b2040 outlines, indigo #4956a7 and pale green #beedae fills, light natural skin accents. Tiny dot eyes, small curved smiles, a few hair strokes, simple original comic children. Rough crayon grain INSIDE the drawn shapes only. No polished vector rendering, realistic anatomy, shading, 3D, gradients, haze, glow or cast shadows. Full composition and all figures visible, balanced wide framing, compact subjects filling the canvas with only a small 5-8% transparent safety margin. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT PNG ALPHA BACKGROUND including all gaps. No backdrop, opaque rectangle, paper texture outside shapes, checkerboard, stray speckles, text, letters, logos, labels or watermark. Scene for the Library services heading: exactly TWO children sitting close together at ONE shared desktop computer on a tiny very simple table. One child uses the keyboard while the other points at the screen, both smiling and looking at the computer. Show the monitor as a simple blank pale green rectangle with an indigo outline and a tiny stand; no screen interface or text. A few straight crayon lines for the table and two small stools, no room or other props. Keep children and monitor similarly prominent, the whole friendly compact group approximately 2:1. Very few lines, minimal detail.
